remarks: Oversized(1170sqft) and updated 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo in hi rise bldg in the heart of downtown Stamford! Gourmet eat in kitchen w/ high end cabinetry, stone countertops and Chef's appliances- stove, dishwasher, microwave, breakfast bar that opens into sunfilled living area with walls of glass and sliders to private, expansive balcony! Large Master Bedroom suite w/ large double closets, luxurious bathroom, and sliders to patio. Generous sized second bedroom with ample closets and modern second bathroom with stand up shower. Gleaming hardwood floors, fresh paint, in unit washer/dryer, air conditioning, clubroom, bicycle storage,1 off street covered gated parking, additional parking space available, pet welcome! Walk to train, shops, nightlife, minutes to highways and beaches! Must see unit in fabulous mid city location!
